dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Primary 'O' structure on the central-right features a sharp, high-contrast perimeter with a rapid gradient transition from dark exterior pelt to light boundary; interconnected complex on the left displays irregular, crenulated edges; smaller circular annuli toward the posterior show softer, more diffused edge boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters along the superior dorsal ridge and the far right lateral region, lacking internal gradients or central voids; lower density of isolated high-intensity blobs scattered between the primary macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangular relationship is formed by the centroid of the large complex cluster on the left and the centers of the two most distinct circular annuli in the mid-lateral section; a linear chain of smaller blobs extends along the upper margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, elongated high-contrast linear boundary line extends from the upper-left anterior region toward the mid-dorsal area, framing the primary texture field.
